backend/main.mo: Actor stores inquiries and exposes submit and query functions with basic validation.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report listing features, affected files, components, and test IDs for design updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing roles of various frontend pages, components, styles, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH theme tokens, dark mode variables, and global background/text styling.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML document loading fonts and mounting the React app entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with all main site routes wrapped in the SiteLayout.
frontend/src/components/CategoryHierarch: Renders navigable glass-style subcategory cards with product type previews and slug-based routing.
frontend/src/components/ProductQuickView: Glass-style modal showing product image, details, features, and an inquiry button with scroll lock handling.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer with company info, links, contact details, branding, and a gold-accent divider.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive site header with logo, desktop and mobile navigation, and active route highlighting.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Page layout wrapper that renders the site header, footer, and routed page content.
Card component generating product descriptions and placeholder images for category/subcategory items.
frontend/src/data/productTaxonomy.ts: Defines product category structures and a full taxonomy of categories, subcategories, and product types.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity authentication, identity loading, login flow, and state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Provides a mutation hook for submitting inquiries through the backend actor and invalidates related queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining color tokens, typography, dark mode, and custom utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entrypoint initializing React, QueryClient, Internet Identity, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About Us page with company background, mission, and differentiators using static text content.
frontend/src/pages/CataloguePage.tsx: Displays catalogue information and features, with a button that navigates to a prefilled catalogue request form.
frontend/src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx: Shows a specific product category with banner, customization note, subcategories, and an inquiry CTA; handles missing categories.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Implements a contact form with validation, category presets, submission handling, and a confirmation screen.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Builds the homepage with hero, introduction, and highlights sections plus navigation to products and catalogue pages.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Lists all product categories as clickable cards that navigate to individual category pages.
frontend/src/pages/SubcategoryPage.tsx: Renders a subcategory page showing banner, navigation, product grid, and a quick‑view modal, using URL params to fetch category data. Handles navigation, inquiries, and product selection state.
frontend/src/utils/slug.ts: Provides helpers to convert text to URL‑friendly slugs and back to capitalized words.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, typography, animations, and plugins for the project’s design system.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s style‑only redesign goals, constraints, and feature requirements for applying a soft‑luxury visual theme.
